scripts.device:android:apk: node ../../scripts/vendor-engine.mjs && expo prebuild --platform android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && echo "APK: $(cd .. && pwd)/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk"
scripts.//device:ios: Physical iPhone, real cluster. Prereqs one-time in Xcode: open ios/*.xcworkspace, sign in your Apple ID (the one on the phone), set a unique bundle id + your team on the target. Then, per build, pass that bundle id + team here. Uses xcodebuild directly, NOT expo run:ios, because prebuild would reset the custom bundle id back to app.json.
scripts.device:ios: node ../../scripts/vendor-engine.mjs && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace groundcoverRUMplayground.xcworkspace -scheme groundcoverRUMplayground -configuration Release -destination "id=${GC_IOS_DEVICE_ID:?set GC_IOS_DEVICE_ID (xcrun xctrace list devices)}" -allowProvisioningUpdates -derivedDataPath build DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="${GC_IOS_TEAM:?set GC_IOS_TEAM}" PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER="${GC_IOS_BUNDLE_ID:?set GC_IOS_BUNDLE_ID}" build && xcrun devicectl device install app --device "$GC_IOS_DEVICE_ID" build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/groundcoverRUMplayground.app
scripts.e2e:app:ios: node ../../scripts/vendor-engine.mjs && EXPO_PUBLIC_GC_PRESET= EXPO_PUBLIC_GC_DSN=http://localhost:9393 EXPO_PUBLIC_GC_API_KEY=e2e-key expo run:ios
scripts.e2e:app:android: node ../../scripts/vendor-engine.mjs && EXPO_PUBLIC_GC_PRESET= EXPO_PUBLIC_GC_DSN=http://10.0.2.2:9393 EXPO_PUBLIC_GC_API_KEY=e2e-key expo run:android
